map.基于坐姿肘高与视线高度的统计均值（约身高 0.46/0.71），属经验推荐区间，: Based on statistical averages of seated elbow height and eye height (about 0.46/0.71 of stature), these are empirical recommended ranges; individuals with different arm and leg proportions can fine-tune.
map.身高超范围怎么办？: What if height is out of range?

map.按身高算出的值只是初始参考，腿长、臂长、坐姿与屏幕厚度都会带来差异。: Height-based values are initial references; leg length, arm length, posture and screen thickness all matter.
map.实测椅高、肘高、眼高优先于比例公式，尤其是身高特别高或特别矮的人。: Measured seat, elbow and eye heights take priority over ratios, especially for very tall or short users.
map.电脑办公桌面深度约 70 cm、书写约 60 cm；空间不足时优先保证视距与肘部: Computer work needs about 70 cm depth and writing about 60 cm; when space is tight, protect viewing distance and elbow support first.
map.显示器尺寸留空或为负会提示，不会带着无效数据算视距。: A blank or negative monitor size is flagged instead of computing a viewing distance from invalid data.
map.按身高算出的高度能直接买吗？: Can I buy furniture directly from the height-based numbers?
map.只能作为初始参考。个体腿长、臂长、坐姿与屏幕厚度不同，建议用实测椅高、肘高、眼高: Only as an initial reference. Leg length, arm length, posture and screen thickness differ; fine-tune with measured seat, elbow and eye heights and prefer adjustable furniture.
map.书写场景为什么没有视距？: Why is there no viewing distance in writing mode?
map.书写/阅读不一定使用显示器，强行给视距会误导。该场景允许显示器留空，只给桌高、椅: Writing/reading does not always use a monitor, so a forced distance would mislead. Monitor size may be blank and only desk, chair and depth references are shown.
